messages.text: That one's a desktop globe — its 10-inch size is made to sit on a desk, shelf, or table, so you're all set there. It's a great pick if you're shopping for a child's room: illuminated and interactive with the augmented reality feature to make learning fun. Is this one for your own kid, or a gift?
That's a lovely gift — grandkids tend to love spinning a globe and finding places on it, especially with the AR feature bringing it to life on a phone or tablet. How old is your grandchild?

Perfect age for it — at 6, the raised relief map and AR illustrations give them something to touch and explore, not just look at, and the illumination makes it a nice little light for their room too. You'll find it under "Replogle Globes 10" Illuminated Globe 4 Kids - Augmented Reality Feature" in search, ready to add to your cart. Was there anything holding you back from it, or anything else you wanted to check before grabbing it?

Good question — you have 30 days for a change-of-mind return, as long as the globe is unused, in its original packaging, with nothing applied to the box. A 20% restocking fee applies to change-of-mind returns, and the return shipping label cost is also deducted from your refund. If it arrives damaged or defective, though, there's no restocking fee — they'll replace or refund it at no cost, you just need to contact them within 48 hours of delivery. Here's the full [Refund & Return Policy](https://replogleglobes.ca/pages/refund-return-policy).

I can't create custom codes, but there's a way to get $35 off: the "Talk with Mia, get $35 off" banner at the top of the site lets you have a quick voice chat (about 20 minutes) with me, and you get a single-use code worth $35, good for 30 days. Want to try that before you check out on the kids' globe?
Sounds good — no rush. Before you go, was there anything about the globe or the shopping experience that almost stopped you from going ahead?
